reward_detail: Rewards change by round, so treat any number you read elsewhere with suspicion. The Binance Intelligence Makes Finance Smarter cycle runs October 12 to October 18 with a 10,000 USDC pool split in two: a 3,000 USDC pool for players who log at least five correct words, and a 7,000 USDC pool for users who also complete $50 in non-zero fee trading on Spot, Convert, TradFi, bStocks, or Futures. Both pools pay by each player's share of correct answers, capped at 5 USDC per user, with rewards set to land in the Rewards Hub by November 1. Some trackers still print a 500,000 Binance Points figure, and that copy comes from older campaigns. Check the live campaign page in-app for the current terms.
